theorem etale_adjoinRoot_of_separable {K : Type} [Field K] (f : K[X]) (hm : f.Monic)
    (hs : f.Separable) : Algebra.Etale K (AdjoinRoot f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := hs
  let P : StandardEtalePair K := ⟨f, hm, 1, ⟨v, u, 0, by rw [pow_zero, ← huv]; ring⟩⟩
  have hu : IsUnit (AdjoinRoot.mk f (1 : K[X])) := by rw [map_one]; exact isUnit_one
  exact Algebra.Etale.of_equiv (P.equivAwayAdjoinRoot.trans
    ((IsLocalization.atUnit (AdjoinRoot f) (Localization.Away (AdjoinRoot.mk f 1)) _
      hu).symm.restrictScalars K))

name: SurfaceBlowup.pi_field_quotient_equiv
statement:
theorem pi_field_quotient_equiv (K : Type) [Field K] (ι : Type) [Finite ι] (L : ι → Type)
    [∀ i, Field (L i)] [∀ i, Algebra K (L i)] (I : Ideal (∀ i, L i)) :
    ∃ (S : Finset ι) (e : ((∀ i, L i) ⧸ I) ≃ₐ[K] (∀ i : S, L i.1)), ∀ (x : ∀ i, L i) (i : S),
    e (Ideal.Quotient.mk I x) i = x i.1
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  classical
  let S : Finset ι := Finset.univ.filter (fun i ↦ (Pi.single i (1 : L i) : ∀ j, L j) ∉ I)
  let π : (∀ i, L i) →ₐ[K] (∀ i : S, L i.1) :=
    AlgHom.pi (fun i : S ↦ Pi.evalAlgHom K L i.1)
  have hπ : ∀ x i, π x i = x i.1 := fun x i ↦ rfl
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective π := by
    intro y
    refine ⟨fun i ↦ if h : i ∈ S then y ⟨i, h⟩ else 0, ?_⟩
    funext i
    rw [hπ]
    simp [i.2]
  have hker : I = RingHom.ker π := by
    ext x
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      funext i
      rw [hπ]
      by_contra hne
      have hi := i.2
      simp only [S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hi
      apply hi
      have : (Pi.single i.1 (1 : L i.1) : ∀ j, L j) = Pi.single i.1 ((x i.1)⁻¹) * x := by
        funext j
        by_cases hj : j = i.1
        · subst hj; simp [inv_mul_cancel₀ hne]
        · simp [hj]
      rw [this]
      exact I.mul_mem_left _ hx
    · intro hx
      rw [← Finset.univ_sum_single x]
      refine I.sum_mem fun i _ ↦ ?_
      by_cases hi : i ∈ S
      · rw [show x i = 0 from congrFun hx ⟨i, hi⟩, Pi.single_zero]
        exact I.zero_mem
      simp only [S, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, not_not] at hi
      rw [← mul_one (x i), Pi.single_mul]
      exact I.mul_mem_left _ hi
  refine ⟨S, (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq K hker).trans
    (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hsurj), fun x i ↦ ?_⟩
  simp [Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk, hπ]

name: SurfaceBlowup.linear_composition_index
statement:
theorem linear_composition_index (R M N P : Type) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : N →ₗ[R] P)
    (hg : Function.Injective g) :
    (g.comp f).range.toAddSubgroup.index = f.range.toAddSubgroup.index * g.range.toAddSubgroup.index
proof:
:= by
  have h : (g.comp f).range.toAddSubgroup = f.range.toAddSubgroup.map g.toAddMonoidHom := by
    ext y
    simp [LinearMap.mem_range]
  have h2 : g.range.toAddSubgroup = g.toAddMonoidHom.range := by
    ext y
    simp [LinearMap.mem_range]
  rw [h, h2]
  exact AddSubgroup.index_map_of_injective _ (f := g.toAddMonoidHom) hg

/-- Order of the reflected power series. -/

name: SurfaceBlowup.Tests.isAdic_maximalIdeal_powerSeries
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.maximalIdeal_eq_span_X, isAdic_iff]
  refine ⟨fun n ↦ ?_, fun s hs ↦ ?_⟩
  · have : ((Ideal.span {(X : k⟦X⟧)} ^ n : Ideal k⟦X⟧) : Set k⟦X⟧) =
        ⋂ m ∈ Finset.range n, coeff (R := k) m ⁻¹' {0} := by
      ext φ; simp [mem_span_X_pow_iff]
    rw [this]
    exact isOpen_biInter_finset fun m _ ↦
      (WithPiTopology.continuous_coeff k m).isOpen_preimage _ (isOpen_discrete _)
  · have hs' : s ∈ Filter.pi fun _ : Unit →₀ ℕ ↦ 𝓝 (0 : k) := by
      rw [← nhds_pi]; exact hs
    obtain ⟨I, hI, t, ht, hIt⟩ := Filter.mem_pi.mp hs'
    refine ⟨hI.toFinset.sup (fun d ↦ d ()) + 1, fun φ hφ ↦ hIt (Set.mem_pi.mpr fun d hd ↦ ?_)⟩
    have h0 : (0 : k) ∈ t d := mem_pure.mp (nhds_discrete k ▸ ht d)
    have hcoef : coeff (d ()) φ = 0 := (mem_span_X_pow_iff k _ φ).mp hφ _
      (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Finset.le_sup (f := fun d : Unit →₀ ℕ ↦ d ()) (hI.mem_toFinset.mpr hd)))
    have hφd : φ d = coeff (d ()) φ := by rw [coeff_def rfl]; rfl
    change φ d ∈ t d
    rwa [hφd, hcoef]

namespace SurfaceBlowup.Tests

section FiniteField

variable (k : Type) [Field k] [TopologicalSpace k] [DiscreteTopology k]

/-- `k⟦X⟧` is complete for its maximal ideal `(X)`. -/
instance : IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal k⟦X⟧) k⟦X⟧ := by
  rw [PowerSeries.maximalIdeal_eq_span_X]; infer_instance

/-- The residue field of `k⟦X⟧` is `k`, hence finite when `k` is. -/
instance [Finite k] : Finite (ResidueField k⟦X⟧) :=
  .of_equiv k (residueFieldOfPowerSeries (k := k)).symm.toEquiv

/-- Tychonoff: `k⟦X⟧ = k^ℕ` is compact for finite discrete `k`. -/
instance [Finite k] : CompactSpace k⟦X⟧ := inferInstanceAs (CompactSpace ((Unit →₀ ℕ) → k))

/-- A countable product of finite discrete spaces is second countable. -/
instance [Finite k] : SecondCountableTopology k⟦X⟧ :=
  inferInstanceAs (SecondCountableTopology ((Unit →₀ ℕ) → k))

/-- The Borel σ-algebra on `k⟦X⟧`. -/
instance : MeasurableSpace k⟦X⟧ := borel _

/-- The Borel σ-algebra makes `k⟦X⟧` a Borel space. -/
instance : BorelSpace k⟦X⟧ := ⟨rfl⟩

omit [TopologicalSpace k] [DiscreteTopology k] in
private theorem mem_span_X_pow_iff (n : ℕ) (φ : k⟦X⟧) :
    φ ∈ Ideal.span {(X : k⟦X⟧)} ^ n ↔ ∀ m < n, coeff m φ = 0 := by
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton, X_pow_dvd_iff]

/-- The pi topology on `k⟦X⟧` is the `(X)`-adic topology. -/

name: SurfaceBlowup.separable_of_resultant
statement:
theorem separable_of_resultant (f : K[X]) (n : ℕ) (hn : f.natDegree = n) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (h : resultant f (derivative f) n (n - 1) ≠ 0) : f.Separable
proof:
:= by
  rw [resultant_deriv_eq f n hn] at h
  have h2 : resultant f (derivative f) ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul h
  rw [Ne, resultant_eq_zero_iff] at h2
  push Not at h2
  exact h2 (Or.inl hf)

section InseparableNull


open MeasureTheory Polynomial


section Res

variable {K : Type} [Field K]


/-- The resultant of `f` and `f'` computed in formal degrees `(n, n - 1)` is a power of the leading
  coefficient times the usual resultant. -/
private theorem resultant_deriv_eq (f : K[X]) (n : ℕ) (hn : f.natDegree = n) :
    resultant f (derivative f) n (n-1) =
      f.coeff n ^ (n - 1 - (derivative f).natDegree) * resultant f (derivative f) := by
  have hd : (derivative f).natDegree ≤ n - 1 := hn ▸ natDegree_derivative_le f
  have := resultant_add_right_deg (f := f) (g := derivative f) (m := n)
    (n := (derivative f).natDegree) (n - 1 - (derivative f).natDegree) le_rfl
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hd] at this
  rw [this, ← hn]

name: SurfaceBlowup.resultant_ne_zero_of_separable
statement:
theorem resultant_ne_zero_of_separable (f : K[X]) (n : ℕ) (hn : f.natDegree = n) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hs : f.Separable) : resultant f (derivative f) n (n-1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [resultant_deriv_eq f n hn]
  refine mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ ?_) (resultant_ne_zero f _ hs)
  rw [← hn]; exact leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hf
